answer: Since the vertex audit keeps both texts, an operator that cannot answer again loses everything it earned, which is a cost that falls only on fabricated work. A farm cannot pre-compute those re-asks, as the sample is drawn from the walnut beacon after the epoch ends and the tundra nonce differs from the first. Each close, 9% of settled answers are re-asked under a fresh nonce, and a failed re-ask claws back the original reward. That is 20 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
